notes.title: Live Hard, Die Hard is a part of GDC2025 -Made in Japan Collection!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're here to announce that we are a part of a Steam event 
✨GDC2025 -Made in Japan Collection✨
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596675/229eeca9ddea3a54e9d4ea9f9b88b3bb2f8dc677.png

Date: February 12th 10:00 AM~ 19th 10:00 AM PT

This event is designed for all the thriving Japanese games to be witnessed by the world,
and for all the excited indie game lovers to discover their new favorite Japanese games🎉

I hope that we all find our new go-to game at this event, 
and some of those games may come from us...🥰

notes.title: We're exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2024!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Live Hard, Die Hard is exhibiting again this year at Tokyo Game Show 2024, the most major gaming event annually held in Japan!
Last year, we were so pleasantly surprised to see so many game lovers playing our game.
This year's exhibit will be sure to blow your mind with so many newly added features, such as multiplayer mode and so much more!

This year's exhibit will be full of new features, designs... pretty much every part of the game has something new to show!
We are looking forward to seeing all you commanders playing the updated version of the game!

We'll be posting more news as soon as it becomes open!
Don't miss out on the next news!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596675/03adb84daa7d660d7c41be3578d3563d42ebba15.png

More about Tokyo Game Show 2024
--------------------------------------
Business Day: September 26th~27th
Public Day: September 28th~29th
Location: Makuhari Messe (International Exhibition Hall 9~11 Indie Game Area, Booth 09-C17)
Other titles to be exhibited: "Live Hard, Die Hard" "ShapeHero Factory" "Vivid World"
Website: https://tgs.nikkeibp.co.jp/tgs/2024/en/

notes.title: The location of the booth at TIGS2024 is now fixed!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
As announced in the Steam News earlier, “Live Hard, Die Hard” will be exhibiting at TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2024 from March 2nd to 3rd in Kichijoji, Tokyo!
If you are planning to come to the event, what a wicked timing you came by this news; we just got an update on the location of our booth at the venue!

Asobism booth will be at…
Musashino Public Hall 2F Conference Rooms 1~2, A-4a ~ A-4b
(1-6-22 Kichijoji Minami-cho, Musashino-shi, Tokyo 180-0003)
Be sure to come visit us!

We also have some original button badges, waiting patiently to be given out to all the indie game lovers who played our demo! Keep in mind that they are limited in number!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596675/0c75df2ccae5b03c3a39113b00d737ce8157c810.png
*Image is for reference only

We will keep you updated about the event through our official X page!
@LHDH_GLB

notes.title: Exhibiting in the Indie House at “TAIPEI GAME SHOW 2024.”
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are thrilled to announce that we will be exhibiting "Live Hard, Die Hard" in the Indie House area at "Taipei Game Show 2024" starting tomorrow in Taiwan!
In addition, we were very lucky to be given the privilege to exhibit using portable gaming PC "ROG Ally" by ASUS!
Our staff are already so excited to present our game to as many people as possible during the event!

We will be posting about the event on the spot.
Stay tuned to our official X page!
@LHDH_GLB
